# Silstone.AI

> Healthcare-native AI studio. We design, build and deploy custom AI
> agents that automate back-office work for medical and dental practices:
> payer underpayment recovery, credentialing portals, denials and appeals,
> prior authorization and inbound fax triage.

We work from your exports, documents and portals rather than integrating
with your EMR, so most builds are live in weeks. Anything touching PHI runs
on AWS Bedrock under a full HIPAA Business Associate Agreement, with a human
approving every action.

## Pages
- [AI Agents for Healthcare](https://www.silstone.ai/): Custom AI agents for healthcare practices, built by people who have run healthcare. Live in weeks, no EMR integration, PHI under a full HIPAA BAA.
- [What We Build](https://www.silstone.ai/what-we-build): A cited knowledge brain your staff can ask anything, plus custom agents that clear the fax pile, chase underpayments and run portals that have no API.
- [Dental Practice AI Automation](https://www.silstone.ai/dental-automation): AI agents for dental practices: clear the fax pile, chase insurance underpayments and run credentialing portals. Live in weeks, no PMS integration.
- [Aesthetics & Med-Spa AI Automation](https://www.silstone.ai/aesthetics-automation): AI agents for aesthetic and med-spa clinics that handle inbound enquiries, bookings and back-office admin, so your team sells time instead of chasing it.
- [Live Demos](https://www.silstone.ai/live-demos): Try free, interactive healthcare AI demos in your browser, no signup: recover revenue from denied claims, and turn a pile of inbound faxes into finished work — refills checked against protocol and cleared in one click, denials assembled into an appeal. Built on Claude.
- [Why Silstone](https://www.silstone.ai/why-silstone): Built inside healthcare, not adjacent to it. Years of practice operations plus years shipping healthcare software, in one small and senior team.
- [Pricing](https://www.silstone.ai/pricing): Priced in three parts so incentives stay honest: a build fee to stand it up, a monthly subscription to run it, and an outcome slice tied to the result.
- [Trust & Security](https://www.silstone.ai/trust-and-security): No EMR integration by design. PHI runs on AWS Bedrock under a full HIPAA BAA, with a human approving every action before anything is filed, sent or paid.
- [Book a Scoping Call](https://www.silstone.ai/contact): Book a 20 minute scoping call. We will find where your time and money is leaking and tell you honestly whether we can help. No integration, no obligation.
- [Blog](https://www.silstone.ai/blog): Field notes on healthcare AI, payer underpayment recovery, credentialing and the back-office admin that quietly drains medical and dental practices.
